Gengyuan Gengyuan ZhangZhang

PhD AI researcher in multimodal intelligence and visual understandingBased in Europe (Germany & UK)

Actively on the job market and open to research collaboration.

I am a final-year PhD student at LMU Munich, working on multimodal AI systems that understand and interact with the visual world. My research spans building multimodal models and agents, evaluating their visual intelligence in the wild, and applying their capabilities to specialized domains. I have also conducted research at the University of Oxford, Amazon, and TU Munich.
